reason: No prior evidence is cited to support any of the key premises. The claims about the initial state of HEA bond coats, the feasibility and outcome of pre-oxidation on HEAs, the diffusion barrier mechanism, improved adhesion, and phase stability are all presented without reference to specific earlier results.
premises: As-deposited HEA bond coats form heterogeneous, underdeveloped oxide scales with limited protective properties
Controlled pre-oxidation can form a continuous, thin alumina-rich passivating scale on HEA bond coats
A pre-formed alumina-rich scale acts as a diffusion barrier to oxygen, reducing further oxidation and spallation
Pre-oxidation improves adhesion between bond and ceramic top coats under cyclic thermal stress
The beneficial effect persists under high-temperature cyclic oxidation conditions without inducing detrimental phase changes
